reference_board_eco.validation: Completed native route: zero DRC violations, unconnected items, schematic parity issues and ERC violations. All 9 Kelvin/analog branches pass terminal-only isolation; 40 drain thermal vias retain correct nets, and 42 local bypass paths are constrained. Motor outputs remain locked and ordering remains on hold.
fabrication_blockers: Qualify USB startup/suspend current, resume timing and rail handovers on hardware.
Review clipped power-copper necks and validate target-current thermal performance.
Complete TI configuration and staged powered commissioning.
validation_helper_corrections: Use actual overlap outside the receiving pad for Kelvin joins; regression distinguishes in-pad from premature joins.
Use KiCad rotation in downward-positive file coordinates for thermal-pad checks.
Measure same-net/layer corridor coverage by geometric length, independent of segment and overlapping zone counts.

completion_work.firmware: Integrated and host-tested TMC5160A pipelined SPI, write acknowledgement, disabled startup, mode/fault checks and thermally scaled low-current STEP/DIR service; released ARM image stays locked until hardware/configuration qualification.
completion_work.ci: Canonicalized only derived trace_length at 1e-12 mm to prevent cross-platform floating-point evidence mismatch. Review validates CAD with the order hold visible; ordering remains separately blocked.
completion_work.motor_phase_copper: Parallel bottom corridor from Q7 drain stitching to R115 input, four new 0.60/0.30 mm transfer vias and 2.4 mm top landing. No Kelvin branch shortcut.
completion_work.pd_configuration: Official TI tool v2.0.1 reached; export pending explicit user approval of its application license. No TI binary invented.
completion_work.physical_evidence: Assembled-board availability, actual load/RPM/stop time and brake/heatsink data requested, not yet supplied.
completion_work.usb_routing: R71 grouped with R72 on top; USB trunks rerouted on B.Cu over a stitched local In2 GND region. Five low-speed signals moved out of the reference layer. Native DRC/parity zero; all four USB reference checks pass, and the previous routing fails the same checker.
completion_work.release_3d: Release export regenerates GLB from the exact final routed circuit, deletes previous output first and requires a valid complete GLB before packaging.
